Help build the next generation of order management.

At SKIDATA, we're transforming our Order Management function into a smarter, more connected and increasingly automated way of working. If you enjoy bringing structure to complex processes, collaborating across teams and continuously looking for better ways of working, you'll play a key role in shaping how customer orders are managed in the future.

Why this role matters

Order management sits at the heart of our customer experience, connecting sales, production, logistics and finance. You'll ensure customer orders move seamlessly from order entry through to invoicing while helping us build a more scalable, data-driven way of working.

As part of our international Supply Chain Management team, you'll also contribute to ERP improvements and explore new automation and AI-assisted solutions, directly supporting both customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

You'll own the complete customer order lifecycle-from order entry through to invoicing-working closely with colleagues across logistics, production, finance, subsidiaries and distribution partners to keep operations running smoothly. Alongside your operational responsibilities, you'll have the opportunity to influence how our processes evolve by supporting ERP improvements, standardisation and automation initiatives.

 * Develop and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures and training materials that support consistent ways of working.

 * Experience in order management, order fulfilment or logistics coordination, with a solid understanding of the customer order lifecycle.
